summary.text: Theresa Wood is a Democratic state representative from Vermont's Washington-Chittenden District who has served since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She served on the House Human Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Theresa Wood assumed office in the Vermont House in 2015 and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026; Washington-Chittenden is a two-seat district.
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as Human Services Committee (vice chair), Joint Fiscal Committee and Justice Oversight Committee.
